name: not-parallel
description: Two parallel lines crossed by a cancellation stroke.
useCase: Indicate that two lines are not parallel.
misuse: Pair this symbol with a clear label when its meaning depends on context.

16.reason: The complete upright lines retain their spacing; a rising cancellation stroke distinguishes the negated form.

24.reason: The shared upright lines and the rising cancellation stroke keep the relation clear beside text.
